title: Service Properties Trust Elects Hospitality Executive Jeanmarie Cooney as Independent Trustee
summary: NEWTON, Mass., September 17, 2026--Service Properties Trust (Nasdaq: SVC) today announced that its Board of Trustees has elected Jeanmarie Cooney as an Independent Trustee, effective immediately. Ms. Cooney was elected in accordance with SVC’s previously announced plan to expand the size of its Board to add an Independent Trustee with significant hospitality experience.
